responsibility: This definition file is the master catalog of AArch64 CPUs and big.LITTLE combinations known to the GCC port. Each AARCH64_CORE entry records the user-visible CPU name, internal CPU and scheduler identifiers, base architecture, extra ISA features, associated cost model, and implementer/part/variant IDs, allowing surrounding code to derive processor enums, tune tables, feature closures, native CPU detection data, scheduler tuning selections, and CPU-specific option handling from one shared source.
